envelope.description: Helper call layer: repair loop, admission per attempt, failure classification

body.title: Helper call layer: repair loop, admission per attempt, failure classification
body.summary: Implement the single-call layer of the shared helper: completeStructured with maxAttempts 1 and internalRetry false, repair prompt built by the helper with the note capped at 8,000 characters, admission before every attempt, and per-call failure classification by cause (call-failed, invalid-reply, unadmittable) with a size refusal reported as divisible before classification.
acceptanceChecks: no provider retries: the real Vibe, Claude and Codex adapters make exactly one attempt per call
a thrown schema-invalid reply is invalid-reply, not call-failed, and a transport failure is call-failed
the repair note is capped at 8,000 characters and admission is checked before every attempt
a size refusal (InputTooLargeError) is reported for division before it is classified

tests.name: handling-call.test.ts: provider called with {maxAttempts:1, internalRetry:false}, repair note capped at 8,000 characters, every attempt admitted before it is sent, no internal retry allowed
handling-call.test.ts: failure classification by cause: schema-invalid is invalid-reply, transport and Vibe exit are call-failed, size refusal divided before classification

provider-failure-kinds.test.ts: real Vibe, Claude and Codex adapters make exactly one attempt on a failing reply; Ollama request carries num_predict 8,192 for parts; malformed replies give invalid-answer, transport failures give model-failed
